targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "heading"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nav" and (r._field == "cog"))

  |> last()

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()

target.query:
from(bucket: "events")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "events" and r._field == "message")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
